review_kind: Read-only source review, separate from implementation; not an external human or security audit
scope: Initial _sum_integer_memory_order implementation, before any high-rank guard

checked: No-axis gate checks both integer/bool input and integer accumulator; bool output, floats, complex, timedelta and explicit axes retain fallback
Per-item existing cast followed by LLVM add without nsw/nuw implements fixed-width modular accumulation
Noncanonical boolean bytes are normalized through the existing BooleanModel
Unsigned magnitude comparisons handle singleton INT_MIN strides without signed negation overflow assumptions
Shape, stride and magnitude remain paired throughout stable dimension sorting
Negative, zero and overlapping strides retain logical multiplicity
C/F flattening respects contiguous data with arbitrary singleton strides; scalars read once and empties read zero times
Existing load_item preserves explicitly unaligned array signatures
source_review.performance_finding: Unrolled O(ndim^2) A-layout sorting generates 496 comparisons plus 2976 selects at rank 32. Bounded diagnostics found substantially increased compilation cost; rank-32 patched subprocess exceeded its 30-second timeout while baseline completed.
source_review.recommendation: Bound the arbitrary-layout rank eligible for unrolled sorting, or use a compact runtime sort. C/F flattened execution need not share this rank bound.

differential_validation.oracle: Python-integer sum of logical elements, reduced modulo accumulator width and signed-decoded where applicable
corpus: 100 uint64/int64 random 3-D arrays with dimensions 2..6, random permutations and signed step sizes -2,-1,1,2; every seventh case additionally broadcast with zero stride; default, int8 and uint64 accumulators (300 cases)
Three layouts of bool arrays backed by bytes including 0,2,128,255,4
Three offset-1 buffer layouts compiled with explicit types.Array(types.int64,3,'A',aligned=False)
A valid rank-4 view with shape (1,2,3,4) and strides (INT_MIN,32,64,8) over 24 int64 elements
differential_validation.input_mutation: No mutation observed for any of the 100 random input views
